info.title: jj-store application API
info.description: Native JJ read contracts. Same-origin Bearer authentication; tokens never appear in paths, query strings or cookies. Shared deployments require TLS. Numeric JSON values retain Rust widths: clients must handle precision beyond JavaScript safe integers explicitly.

get.description: Requires current repository read permission. Unknown query fields are rejected. Source strings are untrusted data. Reads never reconcile or publish native operations.

terms.description:
Native alternating add/remove terms. A sole None means absence and is
excluded from directory listings; unresolved deletions remain explicit.

before.description: Native values at the target; source annotations never replace these.
